heads.t: 曬衣夾一捏就碎？業者揭脆化元凶 曝「這顏色」老化更快 塑膠曬衣夾使用一段時間後，常會出現輕輕一捏就碎裂的情況。日本老牌洗衣用品製造商Nishida解釋，曬衣夾長期在戶外風吹日曬，樹脂材質會受到紫外線、雨水等因素影響而逐漸劣化，變得脆弱、容易裂開。Nishida建議，想延長曬衣夾的使用壽命，最簡單的方法就是不要長時間掛在室外，收衣服時順手將曬衣夾收進室內，就能減緩老化速度。 2 分鐘前｜國際 曬衣夾一捏就碎？業者揭脆化元凶 曝「這顏色」老化更快 2 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The sunclothes are broken when they're caught in the ground. Nishida, an old Japanese laundry manufacturer, explains that long periods of sunburning in the open and that resins are affected by ultraviolet light, rain, etc., and become fragile and vulnerable. Nishida suggested that the simplest way to prolong the use of the sunglasses is not to hang on long enough. Outside the room, when the clothes are collected, they are collected in the room, which reduces the rate of ageing. Two minutes ago, the international suncoat was crushed?
